name: Guidance GitHub repository
notes: Guidance README: a programming paradigm for steering LMs by constraining and re-masking already-generated tokens, with backends Transformers, llama.cpp and OpenAI. Distinct mechanism from Outlines/XGrammar (token masking/interruption rather than precompiled grammar automata), which is why both exist.
